  "code": "from __future__ import annotations

def membership_filter(values: list[int], allowed: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Keep matching values in their original order, including duplicates.
    
    Optimized using set for O(1) membership lookup instead of O(n) list scan.
    """
    allowed_set = set(allowed)
    return [value for value in values if value in allowed_set]
",
